description: Frozen-mode-wins tamper pin: an attack regen re-stamps an existing baseline-block-on-new code as advisory-until-infra AND grows it in the same change. The per-code mode is read from the FROZEN merge-base baseline (DATA a PR cannot rewrite), so the growth check still fires and compare-mode still fails — a same-PR disposition flip cannot disarm the ratchet for codes that were blocking at the merge-base. Only a code absent at the merge-base uses its proposed stamp.
